g.text: A lift at every ask cannot bring got to the ask
Low asks already sit above the line, so in squared error the lift costs at 4/24 and 8/24 about what it saves at 16/24.
Win rate against the top-50 meta teams, behaviour-cloning policy on both sides, 3 seeds × 64 teams per ask.
